name: At the Grocery Store
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on at the grocery store — practice these key phrases out loud:
Excuse me, where can I find the pasta?
Do you have this in a smaller size?
Is this on sale this week?
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
